''See also: [[Naru Huan Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Naru]] Huan is the current ruler of the [[Blackflame Empire]] and the [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]] of the [[Naru clan]]. He ascended to the throne approximately fifty years ago after the original [[Blackflame family]], who had ruled through overwhelming force for five centuries, faded away. The [[Naru clan]] previously served as the empire's traditional administrators and became the public face of the realm due to their reputation for loyalty and their distinctive emerald wings. [[Naru]] Huan is an Overlord, a rare and powerful stage of [[advancement]] that only he has currently reached within the empire. He is described as a heroic and commanding figure with a muscular build, piercing eyes, and large shimmering green wings. In combat, he utilizes an Overlord-level greatsword infused with [[Blackflame madra]] and can manipulate destructive [[green wind madra]]. As emperor, he manages complex political landscapes involving various clans and faces significant external threats to his empire's stability.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Emperor is seen wearing green [[sacred artist's robe|sacred artist's robes]] and possesses wide, emerald wings. He also carries a long, straight-bladed sword crafted from black glass.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|As the [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]] of the [[Naru clan]] and sole leader of the [[Blackflame Empire]], he manages his realm by gathering [[Underlord|Underlords]] and issuing orders to his subordinates. He is a decisive ruler who has considered various administrative assignments for those under his command.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Naru]] Huan is an Overlord who can utilize [[wind madra]] to cushion objects or release powerful blasts capable of tearing apart trees. He is also practiced in combat against [[Blackflame]] and utilizes several sacred weapons specifically designed for that purpose.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Emperor of Blackflame}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The Emperor's support is expected to arrive only after a winner has been clearly established, though his forces possess the capability to cripple an aggressor within a single day should war be openly declared.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c3">''Blackflame'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c5">''Blackflame'', chapter 5</ref> [[Naru Cassias Arelius|Cassias]] believes the Emperor is a figure who will not permit certain actions, and he holds the title to the [[Desolate Wilds]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c7">''Blackflame'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c8">''Blackflame'', chapter 8</ref> [[Naru]] Huan is the Emperor and has attained the Overlord stage.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c11">''Blackflame'', chapter 11</ref> While the [[Jai]] were dissolving into infighting, [[Naru]] Huan could have appointed [[Eithan]] as the temporary guardian of the western territories.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c22">''Blackflame'', chapter 22</ref> While drinking wine, [[Naru]] Huan used [[wind madra]] to cushion a glass and received a [[dream tablets|dream tablet]] from an [[Underlord]] demanding punishment for [[Eithan]]'s conduct in [[Serpent's Grave]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c22" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Imperial duties and lineage}} ===
